An '''Ithorian bounty hunter''' joined a team of other [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] that included [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], and [[Furlag]], among others, in attempting to steal the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen body of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] away from [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in the [[Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].
